programme.title: Teletubbies
programme.desc: Laa-Laa has fun counting to three: 1, 2, 3 rabbits, 1, 2, 3 flowers and 1, 2, 3 trees! Laa-Laa even counts three Teletubbies: Tinky Winky, Dipsy and Po.

programme.title: The Baby Club
programme.desc: Giovanna and Baby Bear welcome babies Reau, Arlo, Oliver, Elijah, Zuri and their grown-ups to The Baby Club. Parents, carers and their babies at home are invited to join in with all the fun activities too! Inside Giovanna’s bag are colourful sheets of sandpaper, and all the parents and little ones have different objects and toys that feel rough. These are explored through discovery, play, song and story. Grown-ups at home are encouraged to take part by hiding a safe, baby-appropriate rough object or toy inside a fabric bag or pillowcase for them to reveal and explore with their baby! The nursery rhyme Michael Finnegan features, as does a story involving Baby Bear and Baby Tiger, and viewers at home show how they’ve been exploring rough things too. The Baby Bear Song gets everyone moving about, before some calm time with sensory lights and the Goodbye Song.

programme.title: Tiny Tunes
programme.desc: Lisa and a group of deaf and hearing children meet in Tall Trees Forest to make cheeky pop-up weasel puppets, then they sing and sign Pop Goes the Weasel, learning the signs for rice and weasel.

programme.title: What’s in Your Plant Pot?
programme.desc: Chilli farmer Amrit Madhoo and the Fact Pack explore the colourful world of chillies. They discover how they grow, how ladybirds help protect the plants, and why not all chillies are spicy.

programme.title: Hamza Loves Animals: Africa
programme.desc: Kipekee the baby elephant and her friends find ways to cool down in the hot sun. Hamza sees vultures in the wild, and some of the animals get weighed at the orphanage.

programme.title: Vegesaurs
programme.desc: Ginger helps a short Broccoliosaurus reach high flowers with a clever solution.

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: Bingo and Bluey have five minutes to bed, which is just enough time to race to the summit of Mount Mumandad. Facing powerful storms, avalanches and stinky spots will take teamwork.

programme.title: Hey Duggee
programme.desc: When Duggee’s old friend Rhodri goes home after a visit, he forgets his favourite hat. No worries, the Squirrels can run after him and give it back. They take all sorts of transport to catch Rhodri, and he is always one step ahead. Until finally, they’re on a raft across the sea and land right by Rhodri’s front door. Is he delighted to get his old hat back? Very. What a journey!

programme.title: Colourblocks
programme.desc: Green arrives, bringing her natural colour to Colourland. Learn about the colour green.

programme.title: Teeny Tiny Creatures
programme.desc: Zola-Rose discovers lots of interesting facts about super-slow snails! Rory and his son Sandy search for snails in the garden and put on a very exciting snail race, while Ferne meets some very rare snails and holds a giant African land snail at the zoo. Also, we find out why snails are so important to the environment. They play an important part in a giant food web.

programme.title: Our Family
programme.desc: Henry plans a puppet show and with the help of little sister Sophie makes a whole host of puppets, including a dinosaur and a princess. But what will the audience think of the big performance? And will the princess escape from the dreaded dinosaur?

programme.title: My World Kitchen
programme.desc: Disa's family comes from the Scandinavian country Sweden. She is baking kardemummabullar, which is a Swedish recipe for cardamom buns. Disa makes a milk mixture, sweetened with honey, and mixes it into flour to make a dough. She then grinds her special ingredient, cardamom, into a powder and adds some into the dough and the rest of it into brown sugar. The dough is flattened, the brown sugar and cardamom mix is spread onto the dough and folded in. The dough is then cut into strips and twisted and wrapped into a bun ready to be baked. Will her friends like the cardamom when it's baked in her kardemummabullar?

programme.title: Maddie's Do You Know?
programme.desc: Maddie has a day out, starting by travelling on a tram. She finds out how it moves using electricity from wire cables above. Maddie jumps on board, and using her special cameras, she shows us how the tram stays in contact with the wire by making an electric circuit to give it the energy it needs. Next, Maddie finds out how maps are made. She meets a surveyor at a new housing estate, who uses a special satellite to mark new roads and houses on a map. Then she visits a mapmaking centre where they keep the Master Map and learns how cartographers make new maps of the UK.

programme.title: Dog Squad
programme.desc: Kika is a golden Labrador and a guide dog for her owner Dr Amit, who is blind. She is trained to use her supersight to help him do as many things as he can by himself. Together, they make the best team! Kika needs to help Dr Amit catch a train to the city. First, they must walk to the station. Kika knows the way like the back of her paw, but there are some important things they must do along the way. Kika has to help Dr Amit navigate a pelican crossing, using a top-secret cone to cross the road safely. Then she must guide him through the station and up the escalator to the platform. There are some hazards to avoid, including a tumbling box full of Kika’s favourite snacks - carrots! Then, at the station, their mission is almost derailed by a last-minute platform change. Can Kika’s supersight save the day?

programme.title: Go Wild
programme.desc: Aneeshwar and Lizzie head out on safari and meet a one-horned rhino. They are semi-aquatic, which means they spend a lot of their lives in water. They can go underwater to graze, eating plants deep down on the river bed. Next, they meet Aneeshwar’s favourite member of the pig family, the babirusa. The males have amazingly long tusks that curl back towards their heads. Today, they meet a mum and some tiny piglets. These two animals are very different, but Aneeshwar and Lizzie discover what the unusual and extraordinary wild connection is between them.

programme.title: Waffle the Wonder Dog
programme.desc: Waffle is an adorable talking dog who can't help but cause trouble! His everyday adventures are full of mayhem and mischief. Warning: theme tune guaranteed to stick in your head.

programme.title: Puffin Rock
programme.desc: Oona really wants to stay up to see the moon tonight – it’s a supermoon!

programme.title: Small Potatoes
programme.desc: Animated series about a group of singing potatoes. Potatoes from around the world celebrate the similarities and differences we all share.

programme.title: Yukee
programme.desc: Sonny and Yukee are distracted by the amazing musical properties of a pile of old salvaged pots. Unfortunately, Sonny has promised some of the pots to Twinkle, who becomes increasingly impatient while Sonny and Yukee play!

programme.title: Maddie + Triggs
programme.desc: When Maddie is invited to play a new game, tennis by sound, she is initially apprehensive - she's worried she won't be able to see the ball! Luckily, Bella the Ball is here to help, and before long, Maddie discovers all the fun you can have when you take the time to listen.

programme.title: Hey Duggee
programme.desc: After overhearing Duggee listening to a beautiful track by the Squirrel Valley Voices Choir, the Squirrels seek to learn more about the roles that make up a choir – basses, sopranos, altos and tenors. A distressed Eugene then alerts them that half of the choir have been taken sick and can’t perform that day. The Squirrels step up to take their place. Initially, when the newly arranged choir sing, the voices aren’t gelling together. Duggee teaches them the principles they must get right first, for the choir to succeed – breathing, pitch, volume, focus and timing. With a lot of practice, the Squirrels turn up to perform perfectly together and finally earn their Choir Badge.

programme.title: Numberblocks
programme.desc: The Numberblocks find a magic Two Tree and play an action-packed game of throwing twos. Learn all about adding and taking away in twos with the Numberblocks.

programme.title: Alphablocks
programme.desc: The adventures of 26 lively letters who can make words come to life by holding hands. From A to Z, every Alphablock has fun discovering the magic of wordplay. I wants to show off her incredible singing but when she holds hands with N, they get stuck inside a floating balloon. Can word magic help them out or will I's singing save the day? This episode introduces the letters I and N and the words tin, tip and pin.

programme.title: Something Special
programme.desc: Justin and George meet Ellie May in a garden to pick lots of tasty fruit and vegetables. Mr Tumble is running his own shop, and Grandad is his first customer. There are tasty strawberries in the spotty surprise. Featuring signs for the words fruit, cucumber and shop.

programme.title: Teletubbies
programme.desc: Tinky Winky, Dipsy, Laa-Laa and Po drive to the Hidey Hup in the Tubby Car. The Teletubbies have fun getting dizzy on the Tubby Spinny.

programme.title: Andy's Dinosaur Adventures
programme.desc: Andy travels back 65 million years to the time of triceratops, a plant-eating dinosaur which roamed the plains of North America. His mission is to find a triceratops horn to replace the one he broke back at the museum. Along the way he comes face to face with the mighty T-rex and meets an ankylosaurus, another plant-eating dinosaur covered in huge armoured spikes. Then he sees two triceratops battle to become leader of the pack. But will Andy find a horn and get back to the museum in time before it opens?

programme.title: Molly and Mack
programme.desc: Molly examines her shelf of special things at the back of Mack’s Stall. She chooses the love heart pencil topper and remembers the day she got it. At the Big Hub, James and Alice have given Molly and Mack the good news – they are officially in love. Molly and Mack are delighted and can’t wait to let everyone know. But James and Alice want to keep their good news a surprise for now, so they can tell Mrs Juniper first. She’s like family after all. It’s not easy keeping something so exciting quiet, however, and before long the news is spreading like wildfire. By the time James and Alice finally get the chance to speak to Mrs J, the cat is well and truly out of the bag.

programme.title: Grace's Amazing Machines
programme.desc: In this episode, Grace gets to grips with three amazingly useful machines! Grace drives and uses a huge accident recovery vehicle and shows off a rough terrain crane. Lastly, she uses an amazing animal rescue machine!

programme.title: Waffle the Wonder Dog
programme.desc: Waffle is an adorable talking dog who can't help but cause trouble! His everyday adventures are full of mayhem and mischief. Warning: theme tune guaranteed to stick in your head.

programme.title: Our Family
programme.desc: Amanpreet gets arty and has a go at painting Mum’s portrait.

programme.title: Octonauts: Above & Beyond
programme.desc: The Octonauts protect some creatures from getting wet when the rain shadow effect fails.

programme.title: Peter Rabbit
programme.desc: When Mittens befriends Cotton-tail, their playful antics lead to trouble. Now Peter must race to save his friend and sister from the clutches of Old Brown.

programme.title: Hey Duggee
programme.desc: The Squirrels see Duggee reading Wonderful Stories about Wise Animals and want to learn about wisdom and how they can become wiser. They find out that wisdom isn’t just about facts and figures, but that it's about good judgement and experiences too. They learn to plan ahead, concentrate on the task at hand, that sometimes big problems need a little help, to focus on the present and that good things come to those who wait. Thank goodness Duggee is so wise!

programme.title: Vida the Vet
programme.desc: Zigzag is surprised to find she can’t rollerskate as fast as she usually runs.

programme.title: Supertato
programme.desc: Supertato, Carrot and Tomato are exploring in the plant aisle when they hear a strange noise. They follow the noise and meet the famous Kiwi the Explorer, who needs their help.

programme.title: The Weasy Family
programme.desc: The Ducklings want to keep ants in the attic, but Weasy is too afraid of the insects. Can he find a way to remove them and keep the Ducklings happy?

programme.title: Mojo Swoptops
programme.desc: Jackson’s big, blue chicken-thing, Ludwig, is going to lay an egg. And it’s up to Mojo and Bo to carry the big bird across dangerous roads to Preston’s egg-hatching shed!

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: Bluey asks Dad to help her draw a dragon for her story.

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: Both Uncle Rad and Frisky accidently turn up to babysit Bluey and Bingo.

programme.title: Zog
programme.desc: Zog cures Fifi’s hiccups with a big dragon roar. But when patients are too scared to be treated by him, Zog must choose between being a scary dragon or a doctor.

programme.title: Football Fantastics
programme.desc: It’s Sophie’s first day. She worries that she’s no good at football but feels like part of the team when she helps the others work together to create a fantastic new football kit.

programme.title: Waffle the Wonder Dog
programme.desc: Waffle is an adorable talking dog who can't help but cause trouble! His everyday adventures are full of mayhem and mischief. Warning: theme tune guaranteed to stick in your head.

programme.title: Rafi the Wishing Wizard
programme.desc: Rafi wishes she was a cat so that she can have a relaxing day being just like Deborah! It is fun at first, but she quickly discovers the challenges. When they are stuck outside in the rain, Rafi admits being a cat is harder than she thought. With Deborah’s help, she returns inside and back to herself again. Together with her dads, they create a magical cat flap, so Deborah won’t get stuck outside ever again.

programme.title: JoJo & Gran Gran
programme.desc: At the wetland centre, JoJo and her friends Alfie, Raya, Jaxon and Isaiah find frog spawn. Gran Gran and Cynthia teach them about the life cycle of frog spawn to tadpole and frog. The friends want to see for themselves, so they each take it in turns to check in on the spawn. Once they’re fully grown, the frogs are found busy hopping all around. But JoJo manages to snap a quick photo of one and finish the life cycle project on the board.

programme.title: Sarah & Duck
programme.desc: Animation. Sarah and her best friend Duck embark on simple but exciting adventures, exploring the world both near and far in their own wobbly and imaginative way. Sarah and Duck dress up as each other and decide to perform a play!

programme.title: Clangers
programme.desc: Major Clanger invents a knitting machine, thinking this will save Granny ever having to make the effort to knit again. But Granny likes knitting, and when she sees the hideous garments the machine produces, she challenges it to a great knit-off to determine who is the best knitter.

programme.title: BeddyByes
programme.desc: MeMo has made a daisy chain, and BaBa marvels at how the flowers are connected. At the Play Tree, they connect little cars together. Meanwhile, at Yummy Time, they discover their sandwiches are connected by melted cheese. MeMo and BaBa drift on the Lullaby Lake while holding hands, connected. Gramma Leeba explains there are many different connections on the wonderful Planet BeddyByes.

programme.title: In the Night Garden
programme.desc: Series for young children about a magical place inhabited by a community of toy characters that care for each other and have fun together. Igglepiggle has lost his blanket. Where could it be? Upsy Daisy helps him look for it. The Gazebo shows them a picture of Makka Pakka, so they visit him and find Igglepiggle's blanket in Makka Pakka's ditch, blocking Makka Pakka's way.

programme.title: CBeebies Bedtime Stories
programme.desc: Rowan Atkinson tells the tale of Norman, a honey-loving bear with a cunning plan.

programme.title: This Is CBeebies
programme.desc: Programmes start at 6.00am.

programme.title: This Is CBeebies
programme.desc: Programmes start at 6.00am.

programme.title: Roots and Fruits
programme.desc: Live from the Roots and Fruits theatre, it’s Banana revealing an astonishing secret about herself in the opera piece, I’ve Got a Secret.

programme.title: Bing
programme.desc: 'You don't need a lot... just a little bit will do.' At bath time, Bing just cannot help adding a few more squirts of bubble goo, and a few more, until he gets more bubbles than he can handle.

programme.title: Teletubbies
programme.desc: Tinky Winky puts Dipsy's hat in the bag - then Noo-noo hoovers them both up! The children in Tummy Tales pack a bag for an overnight stay with a relative, and the Teletubbies do a suitcase dance.

programme.title: Tee and Mo
programme.desc: Explore the amazing world around us with baby monkey Tee and his Mum, Mo. Sing along, join in with stories and get ready for some family fun!

programme.title: Supertato
programme.desc: The Tato Team are having a day off, so Carrot upgrades the Tatoscope to alert Supertato to any of Evil Pea’s plans - and it works straight away! Pea pretends she's hurt her foot so Supertato will invite her into Tato Tower to recover. However, Supertato is so attentive that he doesn't leave her alone. Eventually, Pea shakes him off long enough to try and break the Tatoscope. But it goes into defence mode, and she ends up clinging off it like a bucking bronco. It’s Supertato to the rescue, but he realises she’s been faking it this whole time.

programme.title: Bing
programme.desc: Bing and Sula are painting in the garden. When Bing cleans his brush and accidentally knocks the water over, he goes to fill it up from the garden tap. But he turns the water on too fast, making the hose voosh up into a big snake of water that covers Bing and Sula in wet paint! Flop shows Bing how to turn the tap on slowly.

programme.title: Mojo Swoptops
programme.desc: Mojo and Bo are great at picking apples with Mojo’s crane top. But Preston’s drone might be even better... until it accidentally scoops up Felix. Mojo and Bo are on the chase!

programme.title: Hey Duggee
programme.desc: Even with a bust tyre on race car, the Mice finally manage to chow down on some cheese and see what Duggee’s up to at Squirrel Club. Today, Duggee’s going to do some gardening! Then it is time to learn new fun facts about the sun with Professor Jeanie.

programme.title: Hey Duggee
programme.desc: After the Squirrels tell Duggee that they are feeling sleepy, he insists that some exercise will wake them right up. So together, they set off on a warm-up run. Along the way, they meet characters who are exercising too, and in turn, they learn new and fun ways to work out. They practice their royal waving skills with King Tiger and test out Ethel’s jungle playground – exercise can be fun too! Chew Chew teaches them flexibility and endurance as they all move in rhythm with one another. The Squirrels are amazed by the positive benefits of exercise and understand that it gives you energy, clears your mind and makes your spirit soar – all at the same time.

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: Bluey asks Dad to help her draw a dragon for her story.

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: Both Uncle Rad and Frisky accidently turn up to babysit Bluey and Bingo.

programme.title: Go Jetters
programme.desc: The Go Jetters are adventure-seeking explorers who soar around the planet fixing environmental problems caused by Grandmaster Glitch!

programme.title: Peter Rabbit
programme.desc: When Cotton-tail leaves the burrow in search of her new playmate, the Shrew, Peter must scour the woods and find his sister before a hungry Old Brown does.

programme.title: Octonauts
programme.desc: Join an adventurous team of underwater explorers as they dive into action, rescuing all sorts of amazing sea creatures and trying their best to protect the ocean.

programme.title: Numberblocks
programme.desc: Only Step Squad can save One’s balloon – but what if there’s more than one Step Squad?

programme.title: Alphablocks
programme.desc: The adventures of 26 lively letters who can make words come to life by holding hands. From A to Z, every Alphablock has fun discovering the magic of wordplay. The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog!

programme.title: Piripenguins
programme.desc: When the Emperor Penguin visits the berg, he discovers Pancake is a long-lost prince. Pancake learns how to act royal, but all the attention goes to his head.

programme.title: Playtime Towers
programme.desc: Bella tries to brush Lift’s teeth, but it is too tickly - can the Playtimers help? This gives Hettie an idea for a dance, the Brush Boogie!

programme.title: Bing
programme.desc: Bing is a young and lovable bunny learning about the big world around him, with the help of his friends. A warm and gentle animation, based on the bestselling books by Ted Dewan.

programme.title: Yakka Dee!
programme.desc: Dee encourages a friend to say ‘plane’, and we go on a whirlwind word adventure. We see lots of different types of planes – a flying plane, a landing plane, a taking off plane and a going on holiday plane. There’s a fast plane, some racing planes and even a dancing plane!

programme.title: Lu & the Bally Bunch
programme.desc: Declan gets carried away when he's put in charge of an all-powerful flower.

programme.title: Kiri and Lou
programme.desc: Lou is saved by Kiri from a nightmare in which the Earth seems to have a mind of its own.

programme.title: Froglets
programme.desc: Ziff, Pipp and Button set out to unearth ancient treasures buried in the garden sandpit.

programme.title: Twirlywoos
programme.desc: The Twirlywoos are at a theatre, where they watch the stage manager pressing a button which opens and closes the curtains. When the stage manager takes a break, they decide to press the button themselves and open and close the curtains on an opera singer who is trying to deliver a grandiose performance, much to her surprise! The Box comes to visit the boat and opens to reveal a glowing light and jingling sound. Every time the Twirlywoos try to look inside, it closes again! Eventually, Chickedy and Chick dive headfirst into the Box before it has a chance to close, tipping it up and revealing that it is full of twinkling stars. The stars fly around the boat and out of the top, where they light up the night sky.

programme.title: Something Special
programme.desc: Justin spends the day with a radio star at her school. They record a rap for CBeebies Radio. Meanwhile, Mr Tumble and Grandad Tumble create a Tumble FM radio show.

Initially, when the newly arranged choir sing, the voices aren’t gelling together. Duggee teaches them the principles they must get right first, for the choir to succeed – breathing, pitch, volume, focus and timing. With a lot of practice, the Squirrels turn up to perform perfectly together and finally earn their Choir Badge.

programme.title: Numberblocks
programme.desc: The Numberblocks find a magic Two Tree and play an action-packed game of throwing twos. Learn all about adding and taking away in twos with the Numberblocks.

programme.title: Alphablocks
programme.desc: The adventures of 26 lively letters who can make words come to life by holding hands. From A to Z, every Alphablock has fun discovering the magic of wordplay. I wants to show off her incredible singing but when she holds hands with N, they get stuck inside a floating balloon. Can word magic help them out or will I's singing save the day? This episode introduces the letters I and N and the words tin, tip and pin.

programme.title: Something Special
programme.desc: Justin and George meet Ellie May in a garden to pick lots of tasty fruit and vegetables. Mr Tumble is running his own shop, and Grandad is his first customer. There are tasty strawberries in the spotty surprise. Featuring signs for the words fruit, cucumber and shop.

programme.title: Teletubbies
programme.desc: Tinky Winky, Dipsy, Laa-Laa and Po drive to the Hidey Hup in the Tubby Car. The Teletubbies have fun getting dizzy on the Tubby Spinny.

programme.title: Andy's Dinosaur Adventures
programme.desc: Andy travels back 65 million years to the time of triceratops, a plant-eating dinosaur which roamed the plains of North America. His mission is to find a triceratops horn to replace the one he broke back at the museum. Along the way he comes face to face with the mighty T-rex and meets an ankylosaurus, another plant-eating dinosaur covered in huge armoured spikes. Then he sees two triceratops battle to become leader of the pack. But will Andy find a horn and get back to the museum in time before it opens?

programme.title: Molly and Mack
programme.desc: Molly examines her shelf of special things at the back of Mack’s Stall. She chooses the love heart pencil topper and remembers the day she got it. At the Big Hub, James and Alice have given Molly and Mack the good news – they are officially in love. Molly and Mack are delighted and can’t wait to let everyone know. But James and Alice want to keep their good news a surprise for now, so they can tell Mrs Juniper first. She’s like family after all. It’s not easy keeping something so exciting quiet, however, and before long the news is spreading like wildfire. By the time James and Alice finally get the chance to speak to Mrs J, the cat is well and truly out of the bag.

programme.title: Grace's Amazing Machines
programme.desc: In this episode, Grace gets to grips with three amazingly useful machines! Grace drives and uses a huge accident recovery vehicle and shows off a rough terrain crane. Lastly, she uses an amazing animal rescue machine!

programme.title: Waffle the Wonder Dog
programme.desc: Waffle is an adorable talking dog who can't help but cause trouble! His everyday adventures are full of mayhem and mischief. Warning: theme tune guaranteed to stick in your head.

programme.title: Our Family
programme.desc: Amanpreet gets arty and has a go at painting Mum’s portrait.

programme.title: Octonauts: Above & Beyond
programme.desc: The Octonauts protect some creatures from getting wet when the rain shadow effect fails.

programme.title: Peter Rabbit
programme.desc: When Mittens befriends Cotton-tail, their playful antics lead to trouble. Now Peter must race to save his friend and sister from the clutches of Old Brown.

programme.title: Hey Duggee
programme.desc: The Squirrels see Duggee reading Wonderful Stories about Wise Animals and want to learn about wisdom and how they can become wiser. They find out that wisdom isn’t just about facts and figures, but that it's about good judgement and experiences too. They learn to plan ahead, concentrate on the task at hand, that sometimes big problems need a little help, to focus on the present and that good things come to those who wait. Thank goodness Duggee is so wise!

programme.title: Vida the Vet
programme.desc: Zigzag is surprised to find she can’t rollerskate as fast as she usually runs.

programme.title: Supertato
programme.desc: Supertato, Carrot and Tomato are exploring in the plant aisle when they hear a strange noise. They follow the noise and meet the famous Kiwi the Explorer, who needs their help.

programme.title: The Weasy Family
programme.desc: The Ducklings want to keep ants in the attic, but Weasy is too afraid of the insects. Can he find a way to remove them and keep the Ducklings happy?

programme.title: Mojo Swoptops
programme.desc: Jackson’s big, blue chicken-thing, Ludwig, is going to lay an egg. And it’s up to Mojo and Bo to carry the big bird across dangerous roads to Preston’s egg-hatching shed!

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: Bluey asks Dad to help her draw a dragon for her story.

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: Both Uncle Rad and Frisky accidently turn up to babysit Bluey and Bingo.

programme.title: Zog
programme.desc: Zog cures Fifi’s hiccups with a big dragon roar. But when patients are too scared to be treated by him, Zog must choose between being a scary dragon or a doctor.

programme.title: Football Fantastics
programme.desc: It’s Sophie’s first day. She worries that she’s no good at football but feels like part of the team when she helps the others work together to create a fantastic new football kit.

programme.title: Waffle the Wonder Dog
programme.desc: Waffle is an adorable talking dog who can't help but cause trouble! His everyday adventures are full of mayhem and mischief. Warning: theme tune guaranteed to stick in your head.

programme.title: Rafi the Wishing Wizard
programme.desc: Rafi wishes she was a cat so that she can have a relaxing day being just like Deborah! It is fun at first, but she quickly discovers the challenges. When they are stuck outside in the rain, Rafi admits being a cat is harder than she thought. With Deborah’s help, she returns inside and back to herself again. Together with her dads, they create a magical cat flap, so Deborah won’t get stuck outside ever again.

programme.title: JoJo & Gran Gran
programme.desc: At the wetland centre, JoJo and her friends Alfie, Raya, Jaxon and Isaiah find frog spawn. Gran Gran and Cynthia teach them about the life cycle of frog spawn to tadpole and frog. The friends want to see for themselves, so they each take it in turns to check in on the spawn. Once they’re fully grown, the frogs are found busy hopping all around. But JoJo manages to snap a quick photo of one and finish the life cycle project on the board.

programme.title: Sarah & Duck
programme.desc: Animation. Sarah and her best friend Duck embark on simple but exciting adventures, exploring the world both near and far in their own wobbly and imaginative way. Sarah and Duck dress up as each other and decide to perform a play!

programme.title: Clangers
programme.desc: Major Clanger invents a knitting machine, thinking this will save Granny ever having to make the effort to knit again. But Granny likes knitting, and when she sees the hideous garments the machine produces, she challenges it to a great knit-off to determine who is the best knitter.

programme.title: BeddyByes
programme.desc: MeMo has made a daisy chain, and BaBa marvels at how the flowers are connected. At the Play Tree, they connect little cars together. Meanwhile, at Yummy Time, they discover their sandwiches are connected by melted cheese. MeMo and BaBa drift on the Lullaby Lake while holding hands, connected. Gramma Leeba explains there are many different connections on the wonderful Planet BeddyByes.

programme.title: In the Night Garden
programme.desc: Series for young children about a magical place inhabited by a community of toy characters that care for each other and have fun together. Igglepiggle has lost his blanket. Where could it be? Upsy Daisy helps him look for it. The Gazebo shows them a picture of Makka Pakka, so they visit him and find Igglepiggle's blanket in Makka Pakka's ditch, blocking Makka Pakka's way.

programme.title: American Dad!
programme.desc: Animated series about CIA agent Stan Smith. Stan wants Steve to be popular and goes to desperate measures giving him steroids to make him bigger, better, and part of the in-crowd at school. But when the steroids have an unexpected side effect, Steve gets a lot more attention than anyone expected. Meanwhile, after Hayley makes a movie about Francine's life as a housewife, Francine is determined to start a new career as a doctor.

programme.title: American Dad!
programme.desc: Animated series from the creator of Family Guy about CIA agent Stan Smith. After doing a terrible job standing in for Jay Leno at his boss Bullock's anniversary roast, Stan is reassigned to Saudi Arabia. While his family begins to go through hell, all of Stan's greatest fantasies come true thanks to the country's male-dominated society.

programme.title: Plebs
programme.desc: Sitcom set in ancient Rome. The boys face uncertainty when Landlord evicts them without notice from their flat - Marcus hopes that his parents, who are visiting for the weekend, will help him onto the property ladder, but his dad has other plans for their savings. Meanwhile, Jason's smooth-talking lands him a cushy job as an estate agent.

programme.title: Transaction
programme.desc: Ello Ello: Lively sitcom. Transgender egomaniac Liv is hired to avert a PR disaster at a supermarket, but soon realises she is unsackable and turns the store into a playground. [SL,S,AD] S1 Ep1

programme.title: Piglets
programme.desc: Sitcom set in a fictional police training college. Difficult situations must be diffused to prevent escalation, someone will be expelled if a fellow student reports their misconduct, and there's an unexpected staff sacking.

programme.title: Backyard Builds
programme.desc: Home improvement programme where contractor Brian McCourt and designer Sarah Keenleyside help to expand living spaces by tapping into people's backyards. Mother-and-son duo Paul and Catharine are overwhelmed by Paul's multi-level backyard while Paul also finds his current indoor fitness regime frustrating - Brian and Sarah muscle up to the challenge of building a gym in Paul's backyard while also building a hot tub and a beer tap to help him cool down after a big workout.

programme.title: Deal or No Deal
programme.desc: The iconic TV series is back, but in a brand-new setting with brand-new prize boxes and a new batch of contestants hoping to win a whopping cash prize - who will have what it takes to beat our brand-new Banker? Now hosted by Stephen Mulhern, the series will see contestants battle it out against the notorious Banker to be in with a chance of winning a life-changing cash prize in a nail-biting game of nerves and intuition. Contestants are confronted with 22 sealed boxes with each one hiding a different amount of money - without knowing what each one contains, the contestant must eliminate the boxes, which are opened one at a time, and the amount of money inside is revealed. Pressure mounts as the player is tempted by the notorious Banker to accept an offer of cash in exchange for what might be inside their box, and as long as the larger cash prizes remain unchosen, the Banker's offers will get higher... but that can all change in an instant if a big cash prize is unveiled.

programme.title: Dress To Impress
programme.desc: In Manchester, Jason, Nathan and Jake all hope to impress hotel bookings agent Olivia with their style choices.

programme.title: Billie & Greg: The Family Diaries
programme.desc: Reality series. It's Billie's birthday and Greg has a rather unusual treat in store for her this year - elsewhere, Arthur acts up at a family photoshoot and there's excitement around the gender reveal of a new arrival. Meanwhile, Margot is on the move and Billie and Greg urgently need to babyproof as it's time for her first pair of shoes, but there's massive cause for concern after Chatty drops a devastating health bombshell.

programme.title: The Only Way is Essex
programme.desc: Yaz and Lockie have planted themselves firmly in the honeymoon period. It's a new look for them, and it suits them. No labels, no stress. Surely nothing's gonna rain on their parade.

programme.title: The Real Housewives of Salt Lake City
programme.desc: US reality series peeking inside the unconventional lives of six successful women living in or around Salt Lake City, Utah. Heather receives a devastating phone call on the ladies' final day in Bermuda with incriminating information that affects the rest of the women, Meredith remains in hot water for her role in the rumours about Angie, a bombshell about Heather's black eye is revealed, and someone in the group is exposed and the women must decide if they will cut ties or accept past mistakes.

programme.title: The Real Housewives of Orange County
